title: Employment Protection and Venture Capital Investment: The Impact of Wrongful Discharge Laws
eligible_reason: Replication-stage verification (data/replication_logs/mnsc.2023.01936.md): IC and PP exceptions (staggered policies) enter every regression as additional treatments; GF also reverses in NH and OK
design_notes: WDL_20230921_MS.sas. Table 2 (state level, 1980-2003, 1,200 obs): lnNyr and lnAmtyr (log 1 + count / CPI-adjusted amount of VC deals) on GF IC PP, proc panel fixtwo noint cluster (lines 111-114), then with controls lnpopu lngdp rgdpgr ui homestead lnPB religiosity foia noncompete sbir l5enroll (line 118). Table 3 robustness: 1980-2008 window, drop 2000-2001, exclude CA/MA, exclude AK, ln(VC) instead of ln(1+VC), dC-DH estimator. Table 4 dynamics: GF_1 GF0 GF1 GF2 IC PP (GF_1 = year before adoption, GF0 adoption year, GF1 one year after, GF2 = two or more years after; endpoint binned). Table 5 hazard model of adoption. Table 6 randomised placebo laws. Table 7 firm creation. Table 8 state-sector level (basedata2, 15 EVCA sectors, sorted by state indyr so fixtwo gives state FE and sector-year FE): GF IC PP. Table 9 state-sector dynamics. Table 11 sector-by-sector and labour-dependence buckets with controls. GF coding verified in data: GF == 1 only when year > GFyr (adoption year coded 0).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Within 1980-2003: adoption years 1980 (2 states), 1982, 1983, 1985 (2), 1987, 1989 (2), 1992, 1994, 1998 -> 10 distinct cohorts with pre and post data; 1974 and 1977 adopters are always treated in the window; 36 never-treated states. Computed from basedata.sas7bdat (GFyr by state).
modern_estimators_named: de_chaisemartin_dhaultfoeuille (did_multiplegt, Stata; Tables 3 and 8 robustness, with controls and trends_nonparam on the other two exceptions)
data_files_note: Both SAS datasets read cleanly with pandas.read_sas. VC deal counts/amounts are from Thomson/VentureXpert aggregated to state-year (shipped), so the package is self-contained.
software_notes: SAS 9.4 (proc panel fixtwo with cluster option, proc surveyphreg); Stata 14+ only for did_multiplegt. data/packages/mnsc.2023.01936_regressions.txt is empty because the extraction pipeline does not parse SAS.
priority_note: Borderline. Not eligible under the strict rule (other WDL exceptions IC and PP enter every regression as additional treatments). If the lead treats IC/PP as droppable, Table 2 col 1/3 and Table 8 col 1 become clean GF TWFE specs with complete public data; a GF-only CSA/BJS would be straightforward.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text; readme.pdf read with pdftotext). Treatment coding and cohort counts verified in basedata.sas7bdat: GF == 1 iff year > GFyr; GF2 mean 0.19 confirms endpoint bin. Eleven states adopted IC/PP exceptions in 1983-1987, so IC/PP are highly collinear with the period of GF adoptions.

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: additional staggered treatments IC and PP included as regressors
ineligible_specs.outcome: lnNyr (log 1 + number of VC deals in state-year)
ineligible_specs.treatment_definition: GF = 1 if year > GFyr (state adopted the good-faith exception); IC, PP analogous for implied-contract and public-policy exceptions
ineligible_specs.reported_location: Table 2 column 1 (lnNyr) and column 3 (lnAmtyr, same model)
ineligible_specs.notes: Nearest-to-eligible specification: dropping IC and PP would give a plain GF TWFE. Two-step within-R2 macro (residualise on constant with fixone, then fixtwo) yields the same coefficients as one-step fixtwo.

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying state controls plus IC PP
ineligible_specs.controls: lnpopu lngdp rgdpgr ui homestead lnPB religiosity foia noncompete sbir l5enroll

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: IC and PP included; binned relative-time indicators GF_1 GF0 GF1 GF2
ineligible_specs.treatment_var: GF_1 GF0 GF1 GF2 (with IC PP)
ineligible_specs.treatment_definition: GF_1 = year == GFyr - 1; GF0 = year == GFyr; GF1 = year == GFyr + 1; GF2 = year >= GFyr + 2

ineligible_specs.unit_var: state (cross-section) with indyr (sector-year) as time index
ineligible_specs.time_var: indyr (sector x year); effectively state FE + sector-year FE
ineligible_specs.fe: state + sector-year (proc panel fixtwo by state indyr)
ineligible_specs.reported_location: Table 8 (Table 9 adds GF_1 GF0 GF1 GF2 IC_1..IC2 PP dynamics)
ineligible_specs.notes: Unit of observation is state-sector but the FE structure is state + sector-year, not state-sector + year.

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: did_multiplegt with controls and trends_nonparam(othertreats) on IC/PP; robustness
ineligible_specs.fe: did_multiplegt robust_dynamic dynamic(4) placebo(4) breps(100) cluster(stateno) if_first_diff(ic==0&pp==0) trends_nonparam(othertreats)
ineligible_specs.controls: lnpopu lngdp rgdpgr ui lnpb noncompt homestd sbir foia religion l5enroll
ineligible_specs.data_file: export of basedata (Stata code in SAS comments)
ineligible_specs.notes: Stata command given as a comment block in the SAS file.
